{{Quote|The ''RSO'' gives clones like us a place to take our buckets off. Unlike droids, you can't just fold us up and plug us into a recharge socket.|Captain Rex|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Valsedian Operation">''[[The Clone Wars: The Valsedian Operation]]''</ref>}}
The '''Republic Service Organization''', known also as '''RSO''', was the [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] support unit within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:RSO.png|thumb|left|250px|RSO personnel tending to the clone troopers.]]
The Republic Service Organization was mostly staffed by females and its mission was to support the troops by providing morale, welfare and recreation-type services to the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on leave. They attended to off-duty military members out of the [[Republic Service Organization center]].<ref name="Prelude">''[[The Clone Wars: Prelude]]''</ref> Members of the RSO were frequently depicted in the customized art of the Republic military vessels and vehicles.<ref name="Shadowed">''[[The Clone Wars: Shadowed]]''</ref><ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic Service Organization was clearly derived from the [[Wikipedia:United Service Organizations|United Service Organizations]] that inspired the Imperial Service Organization&mdash;a social network of volunteers founded in 2007 in Phoenix, Arizona, who pledge to support charity organizations such as the [[501st Legion (fan organization)|501st Legion]] in their endeavors, as well as supporting the military away from home.

The Republic Service Organization or RSO, as it is commonly referred to, was brought into the Star Wars universe by Clone Wars comic artist Tom Hodges. Hodges created the two uniforms: dress uniforms for common RSO activities and a "field uniform".
